notes.title: Oculus Headset Bug Fix
notes.notes: We just released an update this morning to fix some issues users were having with an 'Authentication Error' when trying to launch the game on Steam with an Oculus Rift headset. This bug should have been fixed in this update. If you experience any other issues, please contact us via kellyvrstudios@gmail.com
